title: Development of a new measure to check attitude towards water conservation
author: Reddy, Sengupta, et al.
materials: I conserve water whenever possible. Item

steps.title: Construct the Attitude Scale Questionnaire
steps.instruction: Develop a 20-item questionnaire consisting of 5 primary sub-scales and 2 secondary sub-scales to measure attitudes toward water conservation.

substeps.instruction: Create the General Attitude towards water conservation (GAWC) sub-scale with 11 items (Items 1, 3, 4, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 19, 20).
Create the Past Behavior (PB) and Past Experience (PE) sub-scales with 3 items total (Items 2, 5, 6).
Create the Perceived Moral Obligation (PMO) sub-scale with 2 items (Items 14, 15).
Create the Behavioral Intentions (BI) sub-scale with 2 items (Items 17, 18).
Create the Nuanced Analysis of Water Resource (NAWR) sub-scale with 1 item (Item 7).
Create the Perceived Water Rights (PWR) sub-scale with 1 item (Item 16).

steps.title: Collect Participant Responses
steps.instruction: Administer the questionnaire to a target population using digital tools.

substeps.instruction: Deploy the questionnaire in English via Survey Monkey using weblinks, QR codes, and social networking templates.
Collect responses from participants (e.g., N=450).
Filter the data by rejecting responses with incomplete data (e.g., 20 responses rejected).

steps.title: Score the Questionnaire
steps.instruction: Apply a 5-point Likert Scale (Strongly Agree to Strongly Disagree) to the responses, utilizing reverse scoring for negatively worded items.

substeps.instruction: Assign positive scores to Items 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20: Strongly Agree = 5, Agree = 4, Neutral = 3, Disagree = 2, Strongly Disagree = 1.
Assign reverse scores to negatively worded items (Items 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13): Strongly Agree = 1, Agree = 2, Neutral = 3, Disagree = 4, Strongly Disagree = 5.

steps.title: Calculate Sub-scale and Total Scores
steps.instruction: Sum the scores for each sub-scale and calculate the overall attitude score.

substeps.instruction: Calculate GAWC score: range 5 to 55.
Calculate PB/PE score: range 3 to 15.
Calculate PMO score: range 2 to 10 (Note: text mentions max 5 and min 2, but 2 items at 5 points each equals 10).
Calculate PWR score: range 1 to 5.
Calculate BI score: range 2 to 10.
Calculate Total Attitude Score by adding the 5 primary sub-scales (GAWC, PB, PMO, BI, NAWR): range 20 to 100.

steps.title: Analyze Reliability and Correlation
steps.instruction: Perform statistical validation to ensure the internal consistency and relationship between the scales.

substeps.instruction: Calculate Cronbach's Alpha for sub-scales containing more than one item to assess internal consistency.
Perform Guttman's split-half reliability analysis for the GAWC scale (splitting into first half: items 1, 3, 4, 8, 9, 10 and second half: items 11, 12, 13, 19, 20).
Conduct Pearson's pairwise correlation to analyze the relationship between different sub-scales.
